title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stall

translated_title: 直接经验世界模型优化：超越动作模仿学习世界
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型将动作生成与物理交互如何展开的预测相结合。然而，当前的部署后学习范式通常只改进行为，而不需要更好的世界预测。特别是在灵巧操作任务中，微小的执行误差会在高维动作空间中不断累积，阻碍策略改进，并使交互超出世界模型的训练分布。受此启发，我们提出了直接经验世界模型优化，这是一种面向WAM的部署后学习范式，它在动作模仿的同时，通过视觉经验精炼世界表征，以更好地调节动作生成。具体而言，该方法识别交互转折点，并从成功和失败的未来中学习，以支持无分类器引导。额外的价值头从视频表征中估计任务进度，并在进度停滞时激活引导。
tldr: 提出DEWO部署后学习范式，让世界-动作模型在动作模仿之外，通过识别交互转折点并从成功与失败的未来中学习来精炼世界表征，并利用价值头检测任务进度停滞时激活无分类器引导，从而提升灵巧操作中策略的改进能力。
en_tdlr: DEWO is a post-deployment learning paradigm that refines world representations from visual experience—identifying interaction turning points and learning from successful and failed futures—and uses a value head to activate classifier-free guidance when task progress stalls, improving policy adaptation beyond mere action imitation.
